The '''Grand Theater''' was a theater that was located in [[Belleau-a-Lir]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] where dancing took place. After it fell into disrepair, the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] noblewoman [[Cednah Faenel]] paid a large amount of money to restore it.
